title: Cheesy Spinach
content:
Title: Cheesy Spinach
Category: Spinach
Keywords: Cheese; Greens; Vegetable; < 60 Mins; Stove Top
Description: I like this recipe, I for some reason found 4 cheesy spinach recipe cards in my box however this card was well loved, smeared and bent compared to the others LOL
Ingredients: butter; parmesan cheese; frozen chopped spinach; eggs; cream cheese; cheddar cheese; seasoning salt; pepper
Instructions: In Skillet, saute bread crumbs in butter until golden brown; remove from heat, stir in parmesan cheese, set aside to keep warm. Cook spinach as per directions on package omiting the salt in a saucepan.Drain. Return spinach to saucepan. Add eggs, cream cheese, cheddar cheese, onion, salt, and pepper mixing well. Cook over medium heat stirring until the cheese is melted and mixture thickens. Turn into heated serving dish; sprinkle bread crumbs over top. Serve Immediately.

title: Abm Spinach Bread
content:
Title: Abm Spinach Bread
Category: Yeast Breads
Keywords: Breads; Vegetable; Low Cholesterol; Healthy; Bread Machine; < 15 Mins; Oven; Small Appliance
Description: Make and share this Abm Spinach Bread recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: water; spinach; water; bread flour; whole wheat flour; butter; sugar; nonfat dry milk solids; salt
Instructions: Combine the spinach (along with a minimal amount of the cooking liquid if you have it) with 1/2 cup water. Combine stirring and tearing with your favorite pointed kitchen implements until the spinach is fairly well shredded and the water is throughly green. This will produce a tacky texture and a marbled inner appearance. For a greener bread, use a food processor and puree into a shake instead. Combine the remaining ingredients in the bread pan, and set to bake on white cycle. Makes One 1 1/2-pound loaf.

title: Swedish Spinach Soup - Spenatsoppa
content:
Title: Swedish Spinach Soup - Spenatsoppa
Category: Spinach
Keywords: Greens; Vegetable; Swedish; Scandinavian; European; Very Low Carbs; Low Protein; Savory; < 30 Mins
Description: This recipe was adapted from one found in scandinaviafood.com. It is an autumn favorite, typically served with hearty bread.
Ingredients: frozen chopped spinach; flour; onion; water; bouillon; milk; nutmeg; eggs; butter; salt; pepper
Instructions: Drain and dry the defrosted spinach. Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat and add the onion and spinach. Fry until the onions are soft. Dust the flour over the spinach mixture and add the water and bouillon. Let simmer for 10 minutes. Add the milk and season with salt, pepper and nutmeg. Slice the hard boiled eggs. Divide the soup in 4 bowls, and top each with approximately 1/4 of the egg slices. Serve with bread for a complete light meal.

title: Warm Spinach Dip
content:
Title: Warm Spinach Dip
Category: Spinach
Keywords: Greens; Vegetable; < 60 Mins; Easy
Description: I got this from one of my Cosmogirl! Magazines...It was an article of giving a small party and things like that. I ADORE spinach dips! I will post another one I've found from another Cosmogirl! Mag! This looks darn good and seems pretty simple to make!
Ingredients: frozen creamed spinach; swiss cheese; parmesan cheese; sour cream; pepper; salt
Instructions: Mix all the ingredients Together (except the bread) in a large bowl. Cut top off the bread. Carefully remove soft bread inside, leaving a 1-inch-thick bowl. Cut the inside of bread into bite-sized pieces. Pour dip into bowl. Wrap bread bowl in foil but leave the dip exposed. Bake at 350ºF for 45 minutes or until warm (taste to test). Serve with pretzels or bread pieces (the ones you cut out) for dipping.

title: Baked Spinach-Topped Tomatoes
content:
Title: Baked Spinach-Topped Tomatoes
Category: Spinach
Keywords: Greens; Vegetable; < 60 Mins
Description: Make and share this Baked Spinach-Topped Tomatoes recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: onion; garlic clove; butter; fresh spinach; eggs; salt; tomatoes
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. In a large skillet over medium heat, cook onion and garlic in butter until tender; about 5 minutes. Add spinach and cook a few minutes, until tender, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and stir in crumbs, eggs and salt. Set aside. Place tomato halves, cut side up in a 13x9 baking dish (if necessary, cut a thin slice from bottom of each tomato so it stands upright). Mound a scant 1/2 cup of the spinach mixture onto each half. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until heated through.
